Because q1 produced no seeds, q2 (ATT&CK mitigations) was skipped by dependency-chain logic. The answer surfaces none of the 10 required CAPEC ids, none of the 12 required T-numbers/must_correlate ids, and none of the 25 required mitigations (gold_present=0 of 48). deterministic_scores in the artifact itself confirm this: correlation recall 0.0, mapping_recall 0.0/12. No fabricated facts were stated (faithfulness scores clean since the answer made no false claims, only a correct-format abstention), but the abstention itself is factually wrong given the gold ground truth establishes real records exist — so correctness, groundedness, and completeness are all 0.
